$comment: Microsoft Store package identity for the MSIX built by packaging/windows/Build-MsixPackage.ps1.
PLACEHOLDERS. The values below let the package build and sideload-install locally, but
Partner Center will reject an upload until they are replaced with the identity reserved
for SonicRelay under Product identity in the Partner Center (App management > Product
identity). Copy them verbatim - identityName, publisher and publisherDisplayName must
displayName           -> the reserved app name shown in the Store, Start menu and app list
Every value can be overridden without a commit through the matching environment
MSIX_DISPLAY_NAME, MSIX_DESCRIPTION - which the release workflows read from the
repository variables of the same name. See docs/microsoft-store-package.md.
